messages: Maya Patel: Hey team — private deployment collector uploads to our S3 bucket are hitting 403s and causing user-facing 500s. Getting request ID 'req-abc123def' from the app logs. Can someone help gather repro steps and a debug bundle? Tom Lawrence: Can you paste the request id(s) and a curl reproduction (redact creds) if you have one? Also which collector version + redaction config? Maya Patel: Request-ID: req-abc123def Collector version: 2.4.1 Config snippet: `upload: s3://redwood-private-logs/tenant-42/` Firewall: customer NAT + corporate proxy in front. Example curl we used (tokens replaced): ```bash curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer " -X PUT "https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-private-logs/tenant-42/debugbundle.tar.gz?X-Amz-Algorithm=AWS4-HMAC-SHA256&..." --upload-file debugbundle.tar.gz ``` Response: `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden` and S3 error body with `SignatureDoesNotMatch` and the canonical string shows different host. Sylvia Chen: Quick checks: is the collector performing redaction locally before upload, or is it sending raw bundle and presign is used? Which redaction policy (names, ips) is enabled? Also confirm system timezone — I’ve seen clock skew cause signature mismatch on presign uploads. Support Bot: To start a debug bundle run: `/collector gather --output ./debugbundle.tar.gz --include-logs --include-manifest` Then run `./redact.sh ./debugbundle.tar.gz --rules redaction.yml --out debugbundle-redacted.tar.gz`. If you need, I can generate a presigned upload URL for you. Tom Lawrence: Reproducer I used against a presign (replace URL): ```bash curl -i -X PUT \ -H "Content-Type: application/gzip" \ "" \ --upload-file debugbundle-redacted.tar.gz \ --trace-ascii /tmp/curl-trace.txt ``` If that returns 403, attach `/tmp/curl-trace.txt` and the collector upload log (INFO level). Also include the presign response payload from the control plane (we need the exact S3 host/path). Maya Patel: Ran the curl and attached the trace — here's the last lines: `* Connected to s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com (54.231.0.0) port 443 (#0)\n> PUT /redwood-private-logs/tenant-42/debugbundle.tar.gz?X-Amz-Algorithm=... HTTP/1.1\n< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden\n< x-amz-request-id: KX2ABCD1234XYZ\n< x-amz-id-2: ...\n< Transfer-Encoding: chunked\n< \n\n\n SignatureDoesNotMatch\n The request signature we calculated does not match the signature you provided.\n` Also collector log shows `upload failed: 403` and `presign_url_host: s3.amazonaws.com` while the presign payload expected `s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com`. Sylvia Chen: That matches a host mismatch — looks like presign generation used virtual-hosted-style vs path-style or region mismatch. Two immediate repro steps: 1) Confirm presign endpoint generation region (control plane) matches bucket region. 2) Confirm collector is not rewriting the host (proxy or HTTP client). Can you run `journalctl -u collector -n 500 --no-pager` and attach output lines around the upload attempt? Also include `/var/log/collector/collector.log` (INFO+). Maya Patel: Will do. Before I collect everything, can you confirm the exact debug bundle contents you need and any redaction guidance? Don't want to leak secrets. Tom Lawrence: Files we need: `collector.log` (last 1000 lines), `journalctl` output covering the failure window, the manifest generated by `/collector gather` (manifest.json), the presign payload (JSON from control plane), and the curl trace. For redaction: run the provided `redact.sh` with `--mask-aws-keys` and `--salt` (use a random 32-char string). Example: `./redact.sh debugbundle.tar.gz --salt "randomsalt32chars" --mask-aws-keys --out debugbundle-redacted.tar.gz`. That script will replace long creds with stable tokens. Support Bot: NOTE: If S3 presign host mismatch is reproducible, include both the control-plane presign JSON and the collector's interpreted `presign_url_host` field from logs. If upload fails with 403 after redaction, we can provide an alternative SFTP/rsync endpoint — request in thread and we'll generate a short-lived credential. Maya Patel: Ok running `/collector gather` now and will run redact. After that I need a presigned upload URL. Can someone DM a 24h presign? If presign still fails I'll use the rsync fallback. Sylvia Chen: I'll generate a 24h presign and DM it to you. If you see `SignatureDoesNotMatch` again, paste the presign JSON we sent so I can diff it with the collector logs. Also double-check corporate proxy does not rewrite the Host header (some proxies do). Maya Patel: Got it. Thanks everyone — will post back with the redacted bundle upload result. :thumbsup:
